THE STORY

No seasons. Only drops.

VOLT started as a group chat trading graphic tees nobody else had yet. We still run it the same way — small, numbered drops instead of a fixed calendar. No restocks, no filler pieces, nothing held back for "next season." When it's gone, we move on to the next charge.

CARE

Graphic Tees & Hoodies

Wash cold, inside out, low heat or hang dry. Keep prints out of direct dryer heat so the graphic stays sharp.

Rhinestone Pieces

Hand wash or gentle cycle in a bag. Never tumble dry — air dry flat to keep every stone in place.

Leather & Suede

Wipe clean, condition every few wears, and keep boots away from direct heat sources when drying.
